visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: The 'searching' tip of a creeping runner; Top-Right: A pair of small, fleshy oval leaves; Bottom-Left: The tiny attachment hairs (rhizoids) gripping grey rock; Bottom-Right: A cluster of emerging new leaves.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the 'tenacious' and 'wiry' feel of the stems.
